name: Astor Enerji A.S.
summary: Astor Enerji A.S. engages in the manufacturing of transformers, and medium and high voltage switching products for industrial facilities. The company offers power transformers and special type transformers; and distribution transformers, such as oil type distribution, dry type, special distribution, and grounding, as well as MT shunt reactors and magnetic control shunt reactors. It also provides H.V. equipment, including metal enclosed switchgears, RMU, metal clad switchgears, MV switches and disconnectors, concrete kiosk, mobile substation, and HV live-tank circuit breakers. In addition, the company serves energy generation, transmission, and distribution sectors. Astor Enerji A.S. was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Sincan, Turkey.
